ruleDefinitions.name: AWS Identity Center Identity Provider Change
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects a change in the AWS Identity Center (FKA AWS SSO) identity provider.
A change in identity provider allows an attacker to establish persistent access or escalate privileges via user impersonation.
 Note: Unmapped fields: eventSource, eventName

sequences.query: ((eventSource = "sso\-directory\.amazonaws\.com" OR eventSource = "sso\.amazonaws\.com") AND (eventName = "AssociateDirectory" OR eventName = "DisableExternalIdPConfigurationForDirectory" OR eventName = "DisassociateDirectory" OR eventName = "EnableExternalIdPConfigurationForDirectory"))
